models.name: CassandraClusterProperties
models.doc: Properties of a managed Cassandra cluster.

properties.name: provisioningState
properties.doc: The status of the resource at the time the operation was called.

properties.name: restoreFromBackupId
properties.doc: To create an empty cluster, omit this field or set it to null. To restore a backup into a new cluster, set this field to the resource id of the backup.

properties.name: delegatedManagementSubnetId
properties.doc: Resource id of a subnet that this cluster's management service should have its network interface attached to. The subnet must be routable to all subnets that will be delegated to data centers. The resource id must be of the form '/subscriptions/<subscription id>/resourceGroups/<resource group>/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/<virtual network>/subnets/<subnet>'

properties.name: cassandraVersion
properties.doc: Which version of Cassandra should this cluster converge to running (e.g., 3.11). When updated, the cluster may take some time to migrate to the new version.

properties.name: clusterNameOverride
properties.doc: If you need to set the clusterName property in cassandra.yaml to something besides the resource name of the cluster, set the value to use on this property.

properties.name: authenticationMethod
properties.doc: Which authentication method Cassandra should use to authenticate clients. 'None' turns off authentication, so should not be used except in emergencies. 'Cassandra' is the default password based authentication. The default is 'Cassandra'.

properties.name: initialCassandraAdminPassword
properties.doc: Initial password for clients connecting as admin to the cluster. Should be changed after cluster creation. Returns null on GET. This field only applies when the authenticationMethod field is 'Cassandra'.

properties.name: prometheusEndpoint
properties.doc: Hostname or IP address where the Prometheus endpoint containing data about the managed Cassandra nodes can be reached.

properties.name: IPAddress
properties.doc: IP address of this seed node.

properties.name: IsRepairEnabled
properties.doc: Should automatic repairs run on this cluster? If omitted, this is true, and should stay true unless you are running a hybrid cluster where you are already doing your own repairs.

properties.name: autoReplicate
properties.doc: The form of AutoReplicate that is being used by this cluster.

properties.name: clientCertificates
properties.doc: List of TLS certificates used to authorize clients connecting to the cluster. All connections are TLS encrypted whether clientCertificates is set or not, but if clientCertificates is set, the managed Cassandra cluster will reject all connections not bearing a TLS client certificate that can be validated from one or more of the public certificates in this property.

properties.name: pem
properties.doc: PEM formatted public key.

properties.name: externalGossipCertificates
properties.doc: List of TLS certificates used to authorize gossip from unmanaged data centers. The TLS certificates of all nodes in unmanaged data centers must be verifiable using one of the certificates provided in this property.

properties.name: gossipCertificates
properties.doc: List of TLS certificates that unmanaged nodes must trust for gossip with managed nodes. All managed nodes will present TLS client certificates that are verifiable using one of the certificates provided in this property.

properties.name: externalSeedNodes
properties.doc: List of IP addresses of seed nodes in unmanaged data centers. These will be added to the seed node lists of all managed nodes.

properties.name: seedNodes
properties.doc: List of IP addresses of seed nodes in the managed data centers. These should be added to the seed node lists of all unmanaged nodes.

properties.name: externalDataCenters
properties.doc: List of the data center names for unmanaged data centers in this cluster to be included in auto-replication.

properties.name: hoursBetweenBackups
properties.doc: (Deprecated) Number of hours to wait between taking a backup of the cluster.

properties.name: IsDeallocated
properties.doc: Whether the cluster and associated data centers has been deallocated.

properties.name: IsCassandraAuditLoggingEnabled
properties.doc: Whether Cassandra audit logging is enabled

properties.name: provisionError
properties.doc: Error related to resource provisioning.

properties.name: code
properties.doc: The code of error that occurred.

properties.name: message
properties.doc: The message of the error.

properties.name: target
properties.doc: The target resource of the error.

properties.name: additionalErrorInfo
properties.doc: Additional information about the error.

properties.name: extensions
properties.doc: Extensions to be added or updated on cluster.

properties.name: backupSchedules
properties.doc: List of backup schedules that define when you want to back up your data.

properties.name: scheduleName
properties.doc: The unique identifier of backup schedule.

properties.name: cronExpression
properties.doc: The cron expression that defines when you want to back up your data.

properties.name: retentionInHours
properties.doc: The retention period (hours) of the backups. If you want to retain data forever, set retention to 0.

properties.name: scheduledEventStrategy
properties.doc: How the nodes in the cluster react to scheduled events

properties.name: azureConnectionMethod
properties.doc: How to connect to the azure services needed for running the cluster

properties.doc: If the Connection Method is Vpn, this is the Id of the private link resource that the datacenters need to connect to.

properties.name: seedNodes
properties.doc: IP addresses for seed nodes in this data center. This is for reference. Generally you will want to use the seedNodes property on the cluster, which aggregates the seed nodes from all data centers in the cluster.

properties.name: base64EncodedCassandraYamlFragment
properties.doc: A fragment of a cassandra.yaml configuration file to be included in the cassandra.yaml for all nodes in this data center. The fragment should be Base64 encoded, and only a subset of keys are allowed.
